column3: Alright, we managed to protect it!
What are you doing?! Potalia?!
Machines just get in the way! I have only one goal: to bring down Kanjelman!
Let's secure the armory first!
That's the armory! Let's break down the door!
Chirico... that light just now.
What landed deep in the palace was probably a machine sent from HQ... Ypsilon's!
Let's hurry... Borough should be deep inside the palace.
Can't get through here... Let's find another way.
Chirico, look! That wall!
An AT's attack could probably break it...
An AT could probably break it, right?
Couldn't an AT's attack break that?
I don't want to see Ypsilon right now.
Damn, not here either...
Borough and the others are probably way in the back.
Going room by room will take forever.
Chirico, let's split up. We're sitting ducks like this!
I'll be your bullet shield.
Found you! Chirico!
So that's your personal machine.
This machine is top-notch.
Scared now?
Chirico, are you ready?
Please, don't move, Ypsilon...
Chirico... you haven't recovered yet.
You can't win in a straight fight.
Don't forget... we're both fighting in order to live...
This won't work... Fyana, I'll lure Ypsilon in front of the main nozzle.
Wait in the control room... Here I go!
What's wrong, Chirico...?
Don't run!
Fight me, Chirico!
Lost your nerve?
What's wrong, are you afraid of me?
Now! Do it!
Hurry!
Ypsilon... I'm sorry...
All units! Charge!
You won't escape, no matter what... I'll finish you off!
There's no point in coming after me anymore...
Even if you don't kill us, we'll die anyway.
Our tanks are almost empty.
Fine by me! If I get to see you die, I can die happy!
I don't make a habit of shooting women.
Ypsilon... there's no pride in fighting.
There is!
You only think there is.
No... absolutely not...
I have it because I'm me! Because I'm a Perfect Soldier!
You were an ordinary human. You were just remade.
You don't understand! I am a being beyond humanity!
How pitiful...
What?!
You haven't transcended anything.
You're just a sharp human with part of your mind cut out!
Hah?! You dare criticize me?
You're just clinging to a meaningless pride...
I hate you...
Still, it'd be a waste to kill a man who can match a PS...
You don't realize what it means that you were made into a PS.
I'm not interested in that!
I live only to fight...!
...and to win! That's all!
I can read him...
I can see... I can follow his every move...!
Look, Chirico is a PS!
He is not!
Ypsilon is a perfect PS!
Do you think an ordinary human could fight him as an equal?
Chirico is an ordinary human! He doesn't need Jijirium!
Jijirium is not an absolute requirement!
Ability is what matters!
His abilities are those of a perfect PS!
Heh... Chirico himself will prove it soon
By defeating Ypsilon!
No!
Both of you, stop it!
Ypsilon can't move anymore!
Proto One, why... Why did you stop me...?!
Chirico... you are a PS...
We'll break through head-on...
Spread out!
Destroy only the landing craft first! Ignore the small fry!!
We've already lost a third...
But... at this rate...
Don't forget your mission. You only need to fight to keep me alive.
Right, that's enough! Follow me!
No!
Take one more step and I'll shoot!
I'll kill you and then myself!
Well done... Chirico...
I see how firm your will is...
Having come this far, don't you want my power?
Are you, of all people, losing heart?!
What are you doing... Chirico...
Do it now... Chirico!
Heh heh heh... That's 100mm armor! That won't even scratch it!
Hey, kid! Can you at least crawl?
Or are you only good at touching?
It's only a game.
What did you say?!
Battling is a dangerous game...
Hey, Chirico! We're out of time!
This is a cakewalk for you, right, Chirico?
Listen, Chirico! Watch the clock!
If we blow it here, it's all for nothing!
4 minutes left! Chirico!
3 minutes left! Hurry!
2 minutes left! Chirico!
1 minute left! Hurry!
We're out of time!
Hurry! Chirico! We're out of time!
Waah! We're gonna get killed! Chirico!
Chirico, the trailer's under attack!
Chirico! We can't move like this! Take those guys out!
Chirico! Protect the trailer!
Almost there! Chirico!
We did it! Chirico!
Alright, well done!
Hey... this is getting bad, man!
Fighting where there's a crowd of enemies is out of the question!
By order of Melkian Army HQ, the AT airborne unit will now occupy Uoodo.
The Security Police will disarm at once and surrender unconditionally!
Still no contact with HQ?!
So they meant to leave us to die... Damn it!
You in an AT? Now we're unstoppable!
We can't win like this... Stealing an AT is the only way...
Making a big scene would be bad... I need to lure them out and take them one by one.
Today's operation is sudden... because it requires that much secrecy.
The Kummen government is sending replacement ATs to our Assemble.
Our mission is to escort those ATs safely to the forward base.
No good... it won't budge... We've run aground!
Nothing but trouble...
Hurry up and fix the boat!
We hold this position until the boat is fixed! Understood?!
Chirico! This time I won't forgive you!
I'll make you pay for your repeated violations!
Let's go, Shakko!
...Maybe I can pick off just Kan Yu...
Calm down, Chirico. You can do it!
3 minutes left!
2 minutes left! Chirico!
1 minute left! Hurry!
Hurry! Chirico!
We're out of time!
Relax, there's still time.
Stay calm and destroy them one at a time!
Hurry!
Take it easy, Chirico!
Almost there.
We're running out of time.
Calm down, Chirico.
Don't rush, Chirico.
Our orders are to kill Proto One.
He intends to fight.
Don't worry, attack!
But...
Do it anyway!
Ypsilon isn't firing
Target only Proto One...
His subconscious training means he can't attack allies...
Stay close! Proto One!
Step aside! I don't want to hurt you!
Stay back!
Cover me!
Chirico...?!
Are you hurt?
Let's settle this! Chirico!
You know as well as I do this isn't the time for that.
Protecting Fyana comes first right now...
It's faster if we work together... isn't it?
...But!
Just this once... Just this once!
If I run, they'll target me...
Unit 5 sure moves well...
Heh heh, kill him!
What are you doing?! He got away!
That bastard... messing with us!
Did you see that?
That was a Boost Stand...
A mock battle the moment I arrived...
It wasn't just an aptitude test. They called it cannibalism...
A way to sift out a certain purity of ability...
I learned it was brutal, real combat...
Chirico, what's wrong?
...I've seen this place before...
What? But isn't this your first time on Sunsa...?
No, I definitely... know it.
I've been here before...
Chirico, your memory...
There was no doubt...
This landscape... I once...
That's right... What tore my past to shreds was...
The Red Shoulder was disbanded when the war ended.
That's just what they announced...
Hmph... If there are any Red Shoulder ghosts... it might be us.
Long time no see...
Bad timing... We always seem to meet when things are busy...
Heh... Don't worry. I won't burden you any more than needed.
I've fully revived Fyana...
Ah... ah... ahh...
I have been defeated...
Now... I have no choice but to accept him as the Untouchable...
...More of them...
Where's the Jijirium...
These guys are...?!
Fyana's in my right arm... I can't afford to take hits.
Heh heh heh... You're a Red Shoulder, no doubt about it...
And a damn fine one at that...
Chirico... I'm not doing this because I want to...
It's for Coconna and old man Gotho...
Please understand!
Chirico! That's Vanilla!
They're holding us hostage, so he has no choice but to come after you!
Save Vanilla, Chirico!!
The guy watching Vanilla is somewhere nearby!
Unless you take him down, Vanilla... Vanilla will...!
Chirico... I am near... Make haste...
I have waited long... my successor...
Eliminate everything that is armed!
Hey, Chirico! Looks like they're getting serious.
Chirico! Looks like they've gotten serious, too.
Chirico! Those guys look like they mean business now... Be careful!
Chirico, be careful! I have a bad feeling...
Hey, Chirico! Isn't this bad?!
Chirico! This is bad!
Hey, I told you to be careful! Lure the enemy out and take them one by one!
Ch-Chirico! Help me!!
Chirico! Heeelp!!
Chirico! Help me, please!
Please, help!! Chirico!
Hey, Chirico! Give me a hand!!
Chirico! Help!!
Hey, AT78... Stay where I can see you
Yes, Squad Leader... but...
Leave without orders and I'll kill you. Got a problem with that?
Hey, Number 78?! You alive?
Damn... I got hit... and looks like the army's wiped out too...
Are you all right?
Yeah, I'm talking, aren't I... But I'm done babysitting you!
Babysitting...?
I've got orders to report it if you die! Whose precious son are you?
Ow, ow... This is bad...
Let's get to the shallows over there... I can treat your wounds.
You...? ...You're worried about me?
Let's do that. If I'm gonna die, I'd rather die on land...
Aaaargh!
Thanks... It's been years since anyone worried about me...
That whole army was wiped out, yet he survived... The test was worth it.
Found him!
That's a Votoms pilot for ya! You've got guts!
You did it, Chirico! That's my boy!
Phew, we made it somehow, huh, Chirico!
I knew it! No way you'd die on us! Hahaha...
Chirico?! Nothing broken? You had me worried!
You finally did it, Chirico! You're the man I took you for!
Great job, Chirico! That was nothing for you, huh?
Not bad, Chirico. Keep it up next time, huh?
What's wrong, huh? That's not like you...
One step later and you'd have been barbecue!
Wow, yay! Chirico did it!
Woo-hoo! Chirico! You did it!
Never hurts to try! You did it, Chirico!
Ugh, I can't stand to watch...
Aw, looks like you got beat up all over...
I survived again... but the pain stays. Tomorrow I face the next abyss of pain... and then...
What's going on... Nobody's here.
Chirico, they must be hiding somewhere. Be careful.
So you came... strolling right in.
Dirty cheats! Wasn't this one-on-one?! That's not the deal!
He's better than I thought. ...All units, take position!
Surround him and take him down. Don't let him escape!
Damn... Is there no way out...?!
Chirico, looks like we can get out that way!
Chirico, you don't have to play their game. Let's scram!
No good, they're here too! Isn't there anywhere else to hide?!
Chirico, this way!
For a while I didn't know what would happen... but I'm glad you're safe, Chirico
I'm counting on you, Chirico.
